customProps.description: Master physics simulation and environment building with Gazebo and Unity for humanoid robotics development
learningObjectives: Set up and configure Gazebo for physics simulation
Build robot models using URDF and SDF formats
Simulate LiDAR, depth cameras, IMUs, and other sensors
Integrate Gazebo with ROS 2 for complete simulation pipelines
Use Unity for high-fidelity robot visualization and human-robot interaction
